limitations: L4 is offline synthetic fixture acceptance, never real-cohort, biological, causal, physical or clinical validation.

Unpaired two-condition reference only; no sequence processing, absolute quantification, repeated subjects, covariate adjustment or clinical decisions. Partial confounding and power require separate review.
All taxa detected in any extraction blank are conservatively excluded from testing; this does not establish contamination prevalence or detect every contaminant. Zero counts never prove absence.
Hash-bound declarations cannot independently establish historical freezing or true source independence. Independent review and rigor classification remain coordinator-owned.

Conservative English whole-word prefix families (case insensitive): caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Additional blocked terms are truth, physical validity, patient benefit, biomarker and dysbiosis. The gate includes negations and is incomplete for unlisted paraphrases or other languages.

Relative counts never establish absolute abundance or microbial load. Computed agreement and review approval cannot support positive claims; unavailable or empty evidence requires unavailable status. Replicated is refused for this single-study reference.
Labelled sensitivity supports only pseudocount and prevalence changes; other changes remain unsupported. Degenerate draws consume attempts and any failed frozen draw refuses inference.
Artifacts are bounded to 64 MiB each and 256 MiB per bundle across distinct inodes, with a conservative preparse allowance of 4000000 JSON values. Hardlink aliases share read and parse budgets.
